atoms.text: Next, Sally wants to show you some salt marshes and mangrove swamps

instruction.text: This is the River Nene Estuary. Select the water to learn more.

feedback.end: This is a salt marsh on the River Nene on the east coast of the UK. Salt marshes are muddy and grassy areas that are normally covered by the tide for part of the day. They are often found in estuaries, where rivers meet the sea.

instruction.text: Sally wants to do some fieldwork using this map. Answer Sally’s question.

hint.text: Use the plus and minus buttons to zoom in on the map.

atoms.a: “Can you find the key on the map?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f14'>can you find the key on the map</voice>

feedback.end: Great! A key on a map tells us what  different things on the map mean.

atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f14'>Which colour shows a salt marsh</voice>

hint.text: Use the plus and minus buttons to zoom in on the map.

atoms.a: “Now can you find the area with the salt marsh on the map?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f14'>Now can you find the area with the salt marsh on the map</voice>

text: Great Work! The brown colour on this map shows us tidal areas with lots of rivers flowing through them. Here, we can find a salt marsh just like the one below.

instruction.text: Select the river to find out more about mangrove swamps.

text: Great! We find mangrove swamps in tropical regions, such as the Caribbean. They have mangrove trees, which are specially adapted to survive in the salty water.

instruction.text: You and Sally are going to a mangrove swamp to make some observations about its geographical features.

atoms.a: What tool could you use to make some observations?

feedback.correct: Nice! You can use a thermometer to observe temperatures.
feedback.wrong: Saws are not very useful for making observations.

atoms.a: What tool could you use to make some observations?

feedback.correct: Great! You can use a notepad to write down what you observe.
feedback.wrong: Hammers are not very useful for making observations.
